.. _cvm:

CVM
===

`CVM (Comissão de Valores Mobiliários) <https://www.gov.br/cvm/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao-cvm/servidores/estagio/2-materia-cvm-e-o-mercado-de-capitais>`_ is the public agency responsible for regulating, inspecting and to developing of the capital market in Brazil, bringing transparency to investors.

To learn about the tool, download and process of CVM Data, below there is descriptions of the functions. 

- :ref:`Download CVM Data <download_cvm>`
- :ref:`Process CVM Data <process_cvm>`
